follow-up time: From late pregnancy to early postpartum
exposure: Type of childbirth (scheduled C-section vs. other)
outcome: Changes in cortical volume during the peripartum period
finding: Mothers experience cortical volume decreases during pregnancy that partially recover in the postpartum period, with variations in the rate of recovery depending on the specific brain network and mode of childbirth.
mod_finding: Mothers who delivered by scheduled C-section showed different cortical trajectories compared to those who delivered vaginally.
